<<<VERDICT>>>
REVISE
<<<END VERDICT>>>
<<<FINDINGS>>>
- [BLOCKER] R1: `if (Enum.TryParse(targetType, s, true, out object e) && Enum.IsDefined(targetType, e))` calls the non-generic `Enum.TryParse(Type,string,bool,out object)` overload, which does not exist in .NET Framework 4.8. Concrete failure: the net48 TFM fails to compile (CS1503/CS0417), so the patch cannot run on the NT8 net48 runtime and the copier loads no configuration.
- [MAJOR] R1: `var rel = new CopierRelationship();` and `var grp = new CopierGroup();` drop the explicit safe defaults the old loader applied for every numeric/bool field. Fallbacks are now applied only for `Id`, `LeaderAccountName`, `FollowerAccountName`, `GroupName`, and `FollowerAccounts`. Concrete failure: if `CopierRelationship.QuantityRatio` or `MaxPositionSize` lacks a property initializer (or it is later changed), an absent or malformed value silently becomes the CLR default 0.0/0 instead of 1.0/100. The leader continues to trade while the follower copies nothing, reproducing the zero-ratio/zero-cap silent failure the ticket explicitly forbids.
- [MINOR] R1/tests: The provided diff contains no test changes, so this reviewer cannot verify coverage of the six constraints: round-trip of `SizingMode`, `Mode`, `PerTickerRatios`, `CustomSymbolMappings`, `StealthMode`, and `MaxSlippageTicks` across structured Relationships, structured Groups, and flat legacy; unknown-enum no-throw; malformed-number fail-closed; and case-insensitive dictionary lookups.
<<<END FINDINGS>>>
<<<REQUIRED>>>
- Replace `if (Enum.TryParse(targetType, s, true, out object e) && Enum.IsDefined(targetType, e))` with a .NET Framework 4.8-compatible call. Use `try { object e = Enum.Parse(targetType, s, true); if (Enum.IsDefined(targetType, e)) { value = e; return true; } } catch { } return false;` or invoke the generic `Enum.TryParse<TEnum>` via `MakeGenericMethod`. Keep the integer-token branch (`Enum.ToObject` + `IsDefined`) unchanged. Verify the project builds on the net48 TFM.
- In `ParseRelationship` and `ParseGroup`, restore explicit safe defaults for all numeric/bool/enum/list fields before or after `Populate`, not only `Id`/account/name fields. Initialize the objects with the previous loader's defaults (`IsEnabled = true`, `ArmedForLive = false`, `QuantityRatio = 1.0`, `FixedLotMode = false`, `FixedLotSize = 1`, `AutoSymbolConversion = true`, `MaxPositionSize = 100`, `DailyLossLimit = 1000.0`, `IsQuarantined = false`, `MaxSlippageTicks = 0.0`, empty `FollowerAccounts` for groups, and the documented defaults for `SizingMode`/`Mode`/`StealthMode`) so absent or malformed values cannot silently become zero/false due to a missing or changed class property initializer.
- Include the test file changes in the review diff (or reference their paths) so the round-trip, camelCase alias, enum-tolerance, malformed-number fail-closed, and case-insensitive `PerTickerRatios`/`CustomSymbolMappings` constraints can be verified by inspection.
<<<END REQUIRED>>>
